How to apply
How to apply
All vacant positions at the University of Copenhagen are posted on www.employment.ku.dk in one of the categories shown in the menu on the left. Unsolicited applications will not be processed, so keep an eye out for vacant positions on this site.
The application must be submitted via the digital application form. You will find a link to the form in the text of the advertisement or by clicking the APPLY NOW button found at the bottom of the job advertisement.
In addition to your application, you will be able to submit your diploma, CV, references, list of publications, or other relevant documents – all via the application form.
When you have submitted you application you will receive an e-mail verification in your inbox, notifying you that the application has been received.
If you encounter technical difficulties, please try again. If the problem persists, please contact the staff member mentioned as contact person in the advertisement.
